kind_reason: The title marks the document as unpublished results and it reports new cycling data.
title: Cycling of sulfonated cellulose nanofiber separators in zinc–iodine flow cells (unpublished results)

aims.summary: Evaluate the long-term cycling stability of the sulfonated CNF membrane in zinc–iodine flow cells.

findings.summary: The sulfonated CNF membrane completed 500 hours of cycling at 20 mA cm-2 with coulombic efficiency above 98 %.
Iodide crossover stayed below the UV-vis detection limit after 300 hours.
Membrane swelling in the electrolyte stabilised at 18 % after the first 24 hours.

methods.name: SEM
methods.detail: Imaging of the membrane surface after cycling.

datasets.name: SEM images of the membrane surface after cycling

open_questions.summary: Does the membrane remain stable beyond 1,000 hours?
Can the sulfonation degree be reduced without increasing crossover?
